description: Fireweave hooks. One shell-command gate (0656 W6; 1230 §5, layer 3): a plain `fw tool …` command runs without a prompt and any other way of running `fw tool` is refused with the plain form; `gh pr merge … --admin` and `gh api … rulesets` are refused in a cloud agent, CI or with a machine credential and asked about on a developer's machine. Every other command is left to Claude Code's own permissions. One session-start check (0656 W12): in a FireWeave repository, one line naming older FireWeave instruction text or hooks and the command that refreshes them; it never blocks.
